text:
Maya R: quick bring-up notes for sentinel13 (13B) int6 vs int8 on webchat slice (10k sample). headline: int6 cuts token cost ~31% but shows a small QA hit and concentrated hallucination uptick on long-form abstractive tasks. details below.

Jin Park: paste the top-line numbers and table pls.

Maya R: eval-bot summary: cost_delta=-31% (int6 vs int8), qa_acc_delta=-1.5pp, hallucination_delta=+2.0pp, p95_latency_delta=+14ms, n=10000

Maya R: quick table:
```
variant           cost_per_1k  QA_acc  halluc_rate  p95_latency
sentinel13-int8   $0.90        83.5%   2.6%         215ms
sentinel13-int6   $0.62        82.0%   4.6%         229ms
```

Oliver H: where are hallucination failures concentrated?

Maya R: mostly on >2k token abstractive summaries and multi-turn context shifts. short Q&A and code tasks show ~0.4pp QA drop only. priming helps a touch; reranker recovers ~1.4pp halluc but adds ~5-7% cost.

Ava: from GTN perspective: recommended rollout and unit economics please.

Jin Park: routing idea: length-based hybrid (len>2000 -> int8, else int6) or customer-tier route (paid->int8). simulated mix (80% short/int6,20% long/int8) -> effective cost_per_1k ~= $0.68 -> ~24% savings vs all-int8.

Maya R: unit-econ numbers (assume avg tokens/req=1.5k): baseline all-int8 per_1M_req ~= $1,350; hybrid per_1M_req ~= $1,020; savings ~= $330 per 1M requests (~24.4%).

Ava: exec blurb draft for GTN?

Maya R: "Recommend staged rollout: make int6 the default for short, cost-sensitive endpoints while routing long-context/abstractive features to int8. Simulation shows ~24% model-spend savings with minimal impact to critical longform quality. Start with 5% canary -> 25% over two weeks, gate on hallucination spikes, QA-slice deltas, and p95 latency. Fallback to all-int8 if hallucination exceeds 5% for 5 minutes."

Oliver H: ops asks: add per-variant billing tags, emit per-slice hallucination metrics, and implement auto-fallback alarm. also log top failure examples for quick triage.

Jin Park: sim command we used:
```bash
python tools/sim_routing.py --trace traces/webchat_10k.json --policy "len>2000->int8;else->int6" --metrics cost,qa_acc,halluc_rate,p95 --out reports/sentinel13_lenroute.json
```

Maya R: mitigation: tighten priming, lower temp, or apply reranker only for longform outputs. rerank on longform keeps overall cost impact <3%.

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-eval/sentinel13/3166667777/ (per-slice CSV, sim config, top-200 failure examples)

Ava: thanks. will draft GTN playbook language and confirm canary % (5->25).

Maya R: i'll upload the per-slice CSV and sample prompts today and ping when live.

Jin Park: I'll build a small smoke harness to run on canary traffic and emit hallucination_rate + slice breakdown.

Oliver H: if hallucination spikes during canary we rollback routing policy to all-int8 and run a short blameless investigation.

Maya R: end.
